lesson: Reconciliation tie-out across ARR layers: SUM(end_sku_arr) at as_was_date X in arr_line_categories should equal SUM(end_sku_arr) at as_was_date X in arr_sku_categories (after filtering to same as_was_date). Variance < $1 expected. If variance > $1, check (a) override mechanism applied at one tier but not the other, (b) incremental run gap, (c) SSR mid-quarter restructuring.

FLA vs SF reconciliation: SUM(arr_usd_current) at as_was_date X in finance_line_analytics for a given (agreement_id, agreement_line_item_id) should match the converted (TCV / term_in_days * 365) on BASE_PROD.SALESFORCE.APTTUS__AGREEMENTLINEITEM__C TCV__C with udf_tcv_to_arr currency conversion. Mismatch indicates either (a) corrected_tcv via stg_em_lkp_wd_fin_tcv_correction was applied (check), (b) currency rate lookup mismatch (term_start vs close_date), (c) SSR or amendment line not captured in the FLA scope.

Currency variant alignment: a single report MUST use one currency variant. Mixing USD_CURRENT (latest rate) with USD_HIST (historical rate) within the same SUM produces meaningless totals. Default for dashboards: USD_CURRENT. Default for period-over-period trending: USD_HIST. Default for billing reconciliation: USD_ACTUAL.

analyses/audit/ folder is the test-bench for every major model: <model_name>/<model>_compare_relation_columns.sql (schema diff), <model>_compare_column_values.sql (cell-level diff), <model>_compare_and_classify_relation_rows.sql (row presence diff). Pattern: compare CERTIFIED_DEV.<model> vs CERTIFIED_PROD.<model> after a code change. Run before opening any PR that touches a managed/aggregate table.
